description: Lists your security groups, each with its rules (id, direction, protocol, ports, and the other side: an address range or another group). Use the ids with add_security_group_rule, delete_security_group_rule, update_security_group and delete_security_group; set_instance_security_groups attaches groups to a machine, and list_instances shows the groups each machine has.
name: list_security_groups
title: List security groups
